facts.fact: The US State Department says authorities arrested Farhya Houssein on 25 June 2024 for online criticism of the government and a court sentenced her on 17 July 2024 to one month in prison and two years' probation.

The US State Department says the government owned the only radio and television stations and the newspaper La Nation held a monopoly on authorized print media, with official media generally not criticising government policy.
The US State Department says that during most of 2024 asylum and refugee status determinations were not considered, owing to government and UNHCR contractual and administrative impediments.
